{{Quote|Bacta can heal the body, but the Force can heal the soul.|A Jedi healer|<ref name="Threat of the Conqueror">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Jedi Healer}}</ref>}}
A '''Jedi healer''' was a specialized [[Medic|healer]] within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Those [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] that wished to amplify the [[Force healing/Legends|healing abilities]] taught to all at the [[Jedi academy]] who would chose to continue study as a [[Jedi Consular]], working with the [[Circle of Jedi Healers/Legends|Circle of Jedi Healers]] and the [[Medical Corps/Legends|Medical Corps]]. A healer's role in the Order was self-evident and their existence has spanned millennia; the role was described in conjunction with ways of the Consular in the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] approved text, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. The section on Jedi healers was put into writing by the famed [[Jedi Seer]], [[Sabla-Mandibu]].<ref name="TJP" />

Stationed out of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing]], the healers were led by the Circle and practiced their arts on all Jedi needing medical treatment. Using special [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] to amplify their abilities, the most treasured stones were guarded at the Temple, known as the [[Healing Crystals of Fire]]. Drawing on the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]], Jedi healers served not only in hospitals and med-facilities, but also on battlefields during times of war and crisis. Jedi Healers would most commonly have teal lightsabers, but would use them less often.<ref name="TJP" />

While the Circle was a group of highly experienced healers, it was led by a [[Chief Healer]] who oversaw all procedures within the Halls of Healing. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the strict [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi, [[Vokara Che]] held this position, running the facility with a severe dislike for anyone who would interfere in the healing process.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> Following the destruction of the Jedi Order in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the end of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Master [[Cilghal]] was chosen from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] inaugural class of the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order]] to lead the teaching of Jedi students who wished to walk the path of a healer.<ref name="Star Wars: The New Jedi Order">''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''</ref>
